note: Each mutant was applied to the committed lean/VE/Judgments/Status.lean, built with lake (PATH=~/.elan/bin), and the source restored (byte-compared afterwards). Mutants 1 to 4 are the plan's four status seeded bugs; every trusted definition of Status.lean (tools/trust_map.py) has at least one mutant. No Python or Rust product code changed.

mutants.name: status-unused-before-unlisted

mutation.from:
if let some j := deps.find? (!u.listed.contains ·) then throw s!"JudgmentNotListed: {u.id} {j}"
    if u.complete then
      if let some j := u.listed.find? (fun j => J.contains j && !deps.contains j) then
        throw s!"JudgmentListedUnused: {u.id} {j}"
mutation.to:
if u.complete then
      if let some j := u.listed.find? (fun j => J.contains j && !deps.contains j) then
        throw s!"JudgmentListedUnused: {u.id} {j}"
    if let some j := deps.find? (!u.listed.contains ·) then throw s!"JudgmentNotListed: {u.id} {j}"
